extracted.intended_audience: newspaper editors and general news readers (journalists/editors receiving AP dispatches)
extracted.subtask_description: An Associated Press multi-item wartime news dispatch with reports on Greenland/Monroe Doctrine, Pacific/Atlantic naval controls, Norway invasion developments, trade and Treasury actions, and embedded editorial instructions for newspaper editors about inserting follow-up copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editors: insert follow-up paragraph after second graph
rubrics_metrics.description: “EDITORS=TO COVER DEVELOPMENTS THE FOLLOWING MAY BE INSERTED AFTER SECOND GRAPH” (followed by Berlin-night lead paragraphs commenting on President Roosevelt's statement and German official reactions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is explicit AP editorial instruction telling newspaper editors they may add the supplied follow-up material (the Berlin-night lead / commentary paragraphs) after the story's second graph to cover further developments. The inserted text includes suggested lead lines and extended paragraphs from Berlin (e.g., commentary on Roosevelt's statement, German high command communiques, and descriptions of operations in Norway). Use this insertion when local editors want to augment the dispatch with the provided Berlin-sourced material; it is presented as optional copy to be placed after the second paragraph.

rubrics_metrics.name: Note to editors — verification/placeholder for Associated Press investigation
rubrics_metrics.description: “NOTE TO EDITORS | THE ASSOCIATED PRESS IS INVESTIGATING A LONDON REPORT THAT TODAY ANNOUNCED HEINRICH HIMMLER... THE REPORT IS DENIED IN BERLIN” (appears near Vatican/other items).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an AP cautionary note intended for editors indicating that the wire is investigating a particular London report and that the material should be handled accordingly (i.e., treated as unconfirmed until AP verification). It functions as a placeholder informing editors not to present the item as confirmed news without AP confirmation and to await further verification before prominent placement or editorializing.
